pages.text: $(li)$(thing)Cool-season:$() sow as soon as the ground thaws. Sprouts after 120 °C·d above 3 °C.$(li)Ripens after $(thing)2200 °C·d$(). Best near 20 °C; stops above 33 °C.$(li)$(thing)Frost$() kills it below -4 °C (-3 °C in flower).

$(li)$(thing)Soil pH$() 6.5-8 (tolerates 6-8.5). Roots 1 m. Some tolerance of wet soil.$(li)$(thing)Feeds on$() N 180, P 30, K 250 kg/ha per crop.$(li)$(thing)Yield$() when well grown: about 27 tons/ac (60 t/ha).$(li)$(thing)Harvest:$() Sugar Beet and Sugar Beet Seeds.
